ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low; the visible surface is characterized by a high density of low-intensity (dark) pixels with very sparse high-intensity (white) pixel clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: A primary contiguous dark pigment block covers the visible fluke area; discrete high-contrast vertical linear marks are located on the left lobe approximately one-third of the distance from the lateral tip.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped depression at the central midline; vertex pixel depth and angle are partially occluded by water turbulence and spray.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration profile; numerous peaks and valleys with amplitudes ranging from 3-12 pixels visible along the entire continuous trailing edge boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex upward curvature on both lobes, exhibiting a jagged taper towards the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three to four distinct, unaligned vertical white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) located on the medial section of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular tissue loss and jagged serrations along the trailing margins consistent with long-term wear or trauma; vertical white rake marks on the left lobe.
